esporte.lead: Pikivoley is the perfect blend of football technique and volleyball dynamics.
esporte.corpo: The ball goes over the net without ever touching a hand, played only with the feet, head, chest, thigh and knee. It is skill, strategy, agility and teamwork, on any surface: packed dirt, grass or court.
esporte.foto.alt: Pikivoley match on a packed-dirt court: an athlete jumps to head the ball near the net, with another player in the foreground and the crowd around
